source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-18

procedures.title: Ignition system (breaker point): periodic maintenance
steps: Service the breaker points and spark plugs periodically; just inspect the rest of the system for operation, tight connections and wiring condition.
Test the coil with a reputable tester.
Replace the cam lubricator wick whenever the contact set is replaced; do not oil the wick or the cam.
Position a new wick so its end just touches the breaker cam lobe.
notes: The distributor shaft is lubricated from a lube reservoir around the mainshaft in the body.

procedures.title: Breakerless (transistor) ignition: maintenance
steps: No periodic maintenance is needed: the pulse amplifier (forward of the radiator bulkhead) has no moving parts and the distributor shaft and bushings are permanently lubricated.
At overhaul, remove the plastic seal over the upper bushing cavity and add SAE 20 oil to the packing.
Fit a new plastic seal; the old one is damaged on removal.
notes: Breakerless ignition is an option for Corvette only. The lower bushing is oiled by engine splash through a hole in the housing.
